highlights:
## 💡 Schedule ideas from your own messages

The ideas on **Scheduled** can now come from what you ask Nod, such as a reminder for something you do every Friday. Up to two personal ideas appear first. Select one to ask Nod to set it up.

Nod reads only your own recent messages, never its replies, your apps or your files. It checks at most once a day, when you open **Scheduled**, and only after you've written something new. Turn off **Save new notes** in **Settings → Memory** to stop these checks.

## Also in this release

- **Chat:** When a model request fails, the notice with **Try again** now stays until the retry or model switch works. You no longer need to retype your request.
- **Scheduled:** A one-time schedule shows what it cost in the last 30 days instead of "No estimate yet".
